title: Evaluation of the next parity layer
statement: Let $r,q$ be natural numbers, let $G$ be either an AND or OR gate, let $A$ assign a sign block to each of the $r^{q+1}$ groups, and choose an index $i$ in a layer of size $r^q2^r$. Applying the gate dual to $G$ to the specified level-$q+1$ inputs, whose node values encode agreement with $A$, gives the level-$q$ node value at $i$ for the dual gate and the assignment whose $j$th sign is the product of the block assigned by $A$ to child group $(g,j)$, where $g$ is the group component of $i$.
